name: Stage 5:1: Kvarnängens IP Nynäshamn to Vansta, Ösmo
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 5:1, Kvarnängens IP Nynäshamn to Vansta, Ösmo.
utilities: Parking is available at Kvarnängens sporthallar/Kvarnängens IP. The official trail board is by Kvarnängen bus stop on Nynäsvägen, about 100 m from the parking; no all-hours public toilet or tap was verified at the sports halls.

Nynäsgård commuter rail is the practical train approach; follow orange markings past Nynäshamns gymnasium for about 1.9 km to the trail board. No station toilet or tap was verified, and Trafikverket's Nynäsgård rebuild may make station access longer during works.

At the north end, Vansta bus stop is about 0.3-0.4 km from the stage end, while Ösmo station and Ösmo centrum services are about 1.2 km away. ICA Ösmo and Ösmo simhall are opening-hour-dependent services, not trail facilities.

Ösmo simhall can be useful for paid, opening-hour-dependent toilets/showers when open; Willys Sandtorp and ICA Maxi Nynäshamn are larger Nynäshamn-side services near the Nynäsgård approach but are not core trail facilities.

Bus 783 broadly parallels parts of the stage via Kvarnängen, Älgviken, Björsta, Vansta, and Ösmo, giving several practical bailout/access points. Check live SL before starting because bus and train timetables change seasonally.
waterSources: Fjättersjön/Fjättern is described by Sörmlandsleden as a spring lake with good water and rest spots, but no independent potable-water test was found; treat/filter it and carry backup.

Sörmlandsleden says drinking water, toilets, and waste disposal are available through public arrangements in the built-up areas at both endpoints, but exact all-hours public toilet/tap/waste points were not verified. Treat endpoint services as shop, sports-facility, or simhall dependent.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
Access connector from Nynäshamn toward Ösmo/Vansta. Official, Naturkartan, AllTrails, STF, and OSM agree on 9.5 km; disregard the 8.45 km distance found on Äventyrligare for this stage.

The mapped main line is the through-route from Kvarnängen trail board/bus stop to Vansta and measures about 9.31 km. The official 9.5 km catalog distance includes nearby access context, especially the short Kvarnängens IP/parking spur, which should be modeled as a selectable access connector rather than forced into the main line.

The route passes Nynäs gods, Fjättersjön/Fjättern, Valsjö, Björsta, runic remains, Älby grave field, and Vansta gård. The Valsjö/Tuppstensgrottan side trip is worthwhile but has been reported as easy to miss.

Cultural remains along and near the route, including runic remains, grave fields, Valsjö-area historic structures, and fornborg traces around Fjättern, should be treated as protected look-but-do-not-disturb sites. Do not move, dig, cover, alter, damage, or remove anything; report finds instead of collecting them.

No Naturvårdsregistret nature reserve, national park, animal/plant protection area, or Natura 2000 overlap was found for the route corridor, but the stage intersects Berga vattenskyddsområde. Keep toilet needs far from water, do not wash gear or dishes in lakes/streams, avoid fuel or chemical spills, and pack out waste.

Dogs must be leashed through the grazing pasture before Valsjö during May-October. National dog supervision rules are stricter from 1 March to 20 August, dogs should be leashed near grazing animals, and dogs must also be leashed on Nynäshamn/Ösmo public-place areas covered by municipal rules.

No designated campsite is confirmed on 5:1. Camping is prohibited on Nynäshamn public-place areas shown in municipal appendices. Elsewhere, only short allemansrätten tenting may be possible on durable natural ground, away from homes, not on farmland or grazing pasture.

Fires should be limited to prepared Fjättern/Fjättersjön grill places. Nynäshamn lists Öster om Fjättern and Norr om Fjättern/Fjätterns NO strand as bring-your-own-wood sites with no toilet and no shelter. Check current fire-ban status before using any fireplace; fixed public grill places may be allowed under ordinary bans but solid-fuel grilling is forbidden even at fixed grill places under stricter bans.

Fjättern is managed as FK Alcedo club water: fishing requires a valid fishing card, rules can change, and fishing is hand-gear only under the published rules. Boats, canoes, and other floating craft are not allowed. Carry out waste from lake visits.

Recent hiker reports describe the route as generally usable, but markings can be faded in places; keep the map handy. Expect mud or wet ground in spring and autumn, snow/ice in winter and early spring, and possible insects or overgrown vegetation in early summer.

Community reports describe a varied but not especially wild route with road/gravel sections, cultural remains, some traffic/speedway/rail noise, and lower/wetter areas that can be buggy in early summer.
The official page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-26 research pass; verify current notices before hiking.

facilities.name: Kvarnängen trail board and bus stop
facilities.description: Official stage start and trail board by Kvarnängen bus stop. Parking is about 100 m away at Kvarnängens sporthallar.

facilities.name: Kvarnängens sporthallar parking
facilities.description: Start parking for the stage. Coordinate is from OSM parking by the sports halls; visitor rules should be checked locally and no public toilet/tap guarantee was verified.

facilities.name: Nynäsgård commuter rail approach
facilities.description: Commuter rail approach about 1.9 km from the trail board by official orange markings; no station toilet or tap was verified. Trafikverket station works may make access longer during the rebuild.

facilities.name: Fjättersjön / Fjättern rest, natural water, and informal swimming
facilities.description: Natural lake water only; not a verified drinking-water tap or tested potable refill. Filter/boil and carry enough water. Informal swimming/fishing may be possible, but no municipal sampled bathing-place status was found and FK Alcedo/iFiske rules apply.

facilities.name: Öster om Fjättern grill place
facilities.description: Confirmed municipal grill place with stone-ring fireplace, sitting logs, bring-your-own wood, no shelter, and no toilet. Waste/parking are listed within about 800 m.

facilities.name: Norr om Fjättern grill place
facilities.description: Confirmed municipal grill place also known as Fjätterns NO strand or Östra Fjättersjön. Cement-ring fireplace, sitting logs, bring-your-own wood, no shelter, and no toilet; waste/parking are listed within about 1.4 km.

facilities.name: Valsjö / Tuppstensgrottan cave
facilities.description: Dry, narrow cave side trip near Valsjö mentioned by official text and trip reports; it can be easy to miss.

facilities.name: Runic remains near Älby/Björsta
facilities.description: Cultural-remains marker near the route; treat as protected look-but-do-not-disturb heritage. Coordinate is OSM-derived and should be matched to Fornsök before using as an authoritative archaeology pin.

facilities.name: Valsjö grazing pasture warning
facilities.description: Rule warning, not a service point: approximate route area for the May-October grazing pasture before Valsjö where dogs must be leashed.

facilities.name: Älgviken bus stop
facilities.description: Bus 783 access/bailout about 0.2 km from the route.

facilities.name: Björsta bus stop
facilities.description: Bus 783 access/bailout about 0.3-0.4 km from the route.

facilities.name: Vansta-area lean-to
facilities.description: Community-mapped lean-to seen in trip reports and OSM. It is not listed as an official Sörmlandsleden shelter or campsite for 5:1, so treat it as a possible rest shelter only unless verified on site.

facilities.name: Vansta bus stop
facilities.description: Closest bus access near the stage end, about 0.3-0.4 km from the route endpoint.

facilities.name: Ösmo station access
facilities.description: Commuter rail access about 1.2 km from the stage end. Ösmo centrum has services nearby, but no public station toilet or tap was verified.

facilities.name: ICA Supermarket Ösmo
facilities.description: Closest verified grocery/service cluster near the end, in Ösmo centrum rather than directly on the trail. No customer toilet was listed in the checked source.
